record.one_liner: Google's online advertising platform; the Google Ads API lets developers manage accounts, campaigns, budgets, assets and run GAQL reporting programmatically.
record.auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 (single-user or multi-user) or service account. Credentials must be created in the same Google Cloud project where the Google Ads API is enabled. Per the dev-token page, developer tokens were sunset on 2026-09-09 and access is now tied to the Cloud project (App Conversion Tracking API is the exception). Required request headers were not confirmed from a fetched page.
record.access_notes: Enabling the API in a Cloud project gives Test access (test accounts only, 15,000 ops/day). Production accounts need Explorer (apply, automated review, usually approved, up to 2,880 ops/day), Basic (brand verification, automated review) or Standard (manual Compliance review). Free-trial or suspended-billing projects are reported as being rejected. Rate limits for Basic and Standard were not stated on the fetched page.
record.blocker: Production use requires applying for an access level (Explorer/Basic/Standard) per Cloud project, with brand verification for Basic/Standard. Explorer is capped at about 2,880 ops/day. Free-trial billing projects may be rejected. The official MCP server is only read plus partial mutate (assets, labels).
